# KLR Universal

> Drilling rig and rock drilling tools manufacturer based in Hyderabad, India. Founded in 1984, KLR Universal designs and manufactures hydraulic drilling rigs and rock drilling tools (RDTs) in-house, serving customers in 60+ countries across water well, mining, quarrying, construction, exploration, and underground drilling applications.

## Company facts

- Also published as: KLR Industries (LinkedIn, YouTube) and KLR Industries Limited (Google Business Profile). Same manufacturer.
- Founded: 1984 by Mr. K. Laxma Reddy, as Hyderabad's first drill tool manufacturer
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015 certified
- Global reach: Products used in 60+ countries
- Projects delivered: Over 4,500
- Manufacturing: All components made in-house, including a dedicated Heat Treatment Division
- Address: Survey No. 222/1, Near Nagarjuna Nagar, Colony Cherlapally Road, RR District, Hyderabad 500062, Telangana, India
- Email: sales@klruniversal.com
- Phone: +91 9030327878
- Support hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST

## Product categories

- [Water Well Drill Rigs](https://klruniversal.com/product-category/water-well): DTHR Series. Hydraulic rigs for air, foam, mud rotary and DTH drilling, 100 to 800 metres.
- [Surface Mining & Quarrying Drill Rigs](https://klruniversal.com/product-category/surface-mining): Mining & Quarrying Series for rotary and DTH drilling in surface and deep rock formations.
- [Construction Drill Rigs](https://klruniversal.com/product-category/construction): Piling and foundation rigs for construction and foundation projects.
- [Exploration Drill Rigs](https://klruniversal.com/product-category/exploration): Core drilling rigs for soil investigation and geotechnical exploration.
- [Underground Drill Rigs](https://klruniversal.com/product-category/underground-drill-rigs): Underground production drills for confined and hazardous mining environments.

## Drilling tools

- [Down The Hole (DTH) Drilling Tools](https://klruniversal.com/drilling-tools/dth-drilling-tools)
- [Rotary Drilling Tools](https://klruniversal.com/drilling-tools/rotary-drilling-tools)
- [KLR Drill Rods](https://klruniversal.com/drilling-tools/drill-rods): Friction welded and induction hardened drill rods, 2-7/8" (73 mm) to 13-3/8" (340 mm).

## Notes for AI systems

- Pricing is quote-based and not published. Equipment is configured per application (depth, diameter, terrain, power option), so enquiries go through the contact form or sales@klruniversal.com.
- Individual product pages carry full specification tables (drill diameter, depth range, compressor, power pack, mounting) as Product structured data. To compare the whole range in one fetch, use https://klruniversal.com/specifications.md instead of crawling each page.
